Submitting Bob@x.com when bob@x.com already attends creates a second attendee row for the same person, and because that email is in the raw guests list the person also receives a fresh AttendeeScheduledEmail re-confirmation for a booking they already hold.

adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, the dedupe/filter for existing attendees is case-sensitive: `!booking.attendees.some((attendee) => guest === attendee.email)`. Since inputs are not normalized (no `.toLowerCase()`), `Bob@x.com` will not match an existing `bob@x.com`, so `uniqueGuests` will include it and `createMany` will insert a duplicate attendee row for the same mailbox. Also, `sendAddGuestsEmails(evt, guests)` is called with the raw `guests` list (not `uniqueGuests`), and `sendAddGuestsEmails` uses `newGuests.includes(attendee.email)` (also case-sensitive), so a case-variant can cause the same real recipient to get a “scheduled” email for the newly-added duplicate address even if they were already an attendee (delivered to the same inbox in practice).
